purpose: Untimed public QueryEngine plan and stage-aware owner-authentication check, distinct from no-statistics diagnostic
fixture: 192 deterministic SCAN nodes, reopened read-only, number=ID and text=short
query: MATCH (n:Nodes) WHERE n.number >= 2 RETURN sum(n.number) AS total, count(n.text) AS present
plan: QueryEngine.buildPlan with its normal statistics provider and cache behavior; execute the exact returned plan via executePlan
events: test-only selected/nonnull/other authentication events keyed by synthetic owner ID; count owners seen in both selected and nonnull stages
interpretation: no latency attribution; public plan result may differ from the explicit caller-owned snapshot diagnostic. This evidence does not grant authority or prove a safe production reuse mechanism.
